newsitem.title: USA: Bank of Commerce sees higher Q3 profits.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Commerce sees higher Q3 profits.

text.p: Bank of Commerce said Thursday it expects income from loan sales will contribute to to an expected 20 to 30 percent increase in profits in the third quarter ending in September.
The company plans to resume secondary market sales of some of its SBA loans in order to enhance profitability.
"Accelerating demand for SBA loans has helped us quickly complete our plan to build a solid portfolio of loans," Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Peter Davis said in a statement.
"We are now generating more loans than we can portfolio, based on current capital levels, and have decided to resume sales of a portion of our future loan production on a quarterly basis."
In last year's third quarter, Bank of Commerce earned $951,000, or $0.45 per share.
